name: Bromos Grummner
summary: In Anvilmar, Bromos Grummner guides young dwarven paladins in the Holy Light and welcomes them to its discipline. He teaches steadfast faith and the bond between dwarves and humans in the Knights of the Silver Hand.

sections.title: A Beacon in Coldridge
sections.body: In Anvilmar, Bromos teaches young paladins the rites of battle and sacred invocations. Yet he speaks of more than combat. The Knights of the Silver Hand unite Ironforge and the human kingdoms of the Alliance in a shared righteous purpose.

faq.answer: Bromos Grummner trains new dwarven paladins in Anvilmar, in Coldridge Valley within Dun Morogh. He gives them basic training, spells, and spiritual guidance.
Bromos represents the Knights of the Silver Hand. He teaches the bond between humans and dwarves, forged beneath the holy order's banner.

faq.q: What does he teach new recruits?
faq.answer: Bromos teaches new paladins basic combat arts and divine spells. He sets early trials for initiates to prove their devotion to the Light and their readiness to protect Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a dwarven paladin, you can look to Bromos as your first spiritual mentor. He introduces you to the sacred duties of the Silver Hand.
As a dwarf, you follow a long tradition of devotion to the Light and fight beside your human allies.
